scenario: LSER.6.8.1 at runtime — a labelled series read resolves to a value a rule can match on. Positive control for RDSC.5a.8.1_two_windows_disagree: every other labelled-access fixture is compiler-category. One window, one label, so the only thing it can fail on is the labelled read itself. The second assert is load-bearing and not padding: LSER.8.6.1 makes the read in the pump that first asserts a fact a PRE-SAMPLE read, which answers cold — the value 100.0 is only in the backing by the pump that follows, and the slots differ so the reassert is not suppressed as a no-op.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable

series Sensor.val:
    mean sliding 10_min as recent

rule recent_high:
    Sensor s where s.recent.mean > 75.0
->
    log info "recent high"
